verdict.rationale: Stripe publishes an official machine-readable OpenAPI spec in JSON and YAML, with GA and preview variants, in the stripe/openapi GitHub repository. The published spec3.json includes the Identity resources such as identity.verification_session, so Identity's API can be downloaded as part of the platform spec. The probe's 404s on docs.stripe.com/openapi.json and similar paths only show the spec lives on GitHub rather than at those URLs; they do not contradict its existence. Missing for 10: no Identity-specific spec file, no discoverable spec at conventional docs-site paths, no independent hands-on corroboration of consuming the spec.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)

citations.quote: Stripe publishes its machine-readable API specification in the official stripe/openapi repository (latest GA plus preview variants, JSON and YAML).
The published spec3.json itself carries the Identity resources (identity.verification_session and related schemas), so the Identity API is machine-readable through the platform spec.
